title: babcf05e/SE: Multithread scaled kernels
description:
V10 multithread step. Only applied after the single-thread spiral is sharp on each target kernel — multithreading a memory-bound kernel just adds bus contention.

## Children (2 tasks)

- **E1** — Tier B1/B3 dense ops via rayon row-tile (`crates/gf2-core/src/compute/cpu.rs`). Pre-flight: confirm single-thread is not memory-bound by checking `perf stat` cache-miss rate on the post-Tier-B kernel.
- **E2** — Tier C4/C5 batch field ops via rayon SoA chunks (new `compute/field.rs` module).

## Depends on

E1 blocks on all of SB. E2 blocks on C4 and C5.

## Success criteria

- [hard] Strong-scaling efficiency ≥ 70% at 4 threads on the design size class.
- [hard] No correctness regression vs. single-threaded path.
- [aspirational] ≥ 3× total speedup over the post-single-thread baseline at 4 threads.
